hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/record.json"; g=/dev/null; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/runtime/glance.json"; [ -f "$r" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && [ -r "$d" ] && [ "$d" -nt "$r" ] && g="$d"; jq -nc --rawfile glance "$g" --arg root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-bash.jq" - "$r" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/end.json" 2>/dev/null || true
jq -c -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/approve-ask.jq" 2>/dev/null | { IFS= read -r in && bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/approve-ask.sh" "$in"; } 2>/dev/null || true

r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/record.json"; g=/dev/null; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/runtime/glance.json"; [ -f "$r" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && [ -r "$d" ] && [ "$d" -nt "$r" ] && g="$d"; jq -nc --rawfile glance "$g" --arg root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-file.jq" - "$r" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/end.json" 2>/dev/null || true
